podcast.title: Dutch Beatmaker and Old Town Road
podcast.body: This Dutch beatmaker remixed the Nine Inch Nails instrumental track "34 Ghosts 4" and sold the result online for $30. This remix was then purchased by Montero Hill (Lil Nas X) and became the basis for "Old Town Road." "A Dutch beatmaker named Young Kiel took up Trent on his offer. He messed with one of the tracks called 34 Ghosts 4 and put the results up for sale online for $30."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Producer of "Old Town Road" Beat
podcast.body: Young Kio, a Dutch record producer, created the beat for Lil Nas X's "Old Town Road" by manipulating a sample from Nine Inch Nails' instrumental track "34 Ghosts 4" and selling it for $30 on his online store, where Lil Nas X purchased it. His real name is Kioa Rokima. "He stumbled upon a track called 34 Ghosts 4, an instrumental from the 2008 Nine-H Nails album Ghost 1-4."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Producer of "Old Town Road" Beat
podcast.body: Young Kioh, a Dutch producer, created the beat for Lil Nas X's "Old Town Road" based on Nine Inch Nails' "34 Ghosts 4." Lil Nas X purchased this beat online for $30. Young Kioh was unaware of the beat's use until the song became a massive hit. Through a quiet negotiation, he received songwriting credits, a share of the profits, and shared in the Grammy wins for the song. "He found a Dutch kid by the name of Young Kioh, who had created a beat based on a track called 34 Ghosts 4."
